title: Component ablations of bsc_6 (development comparison, descriptive)
design: Each arm changes exactly ONE component of the final bsc_6 detector (history channel off already). Each arm gets its own calibration refitted from the same controls/captures/cached measurements (no training, no inference). Arms are run as --development-gate-run filter runs of the Phase 2d attack on development seeds 43 and 46; the full bsc_6 reference is logs/bsc6_devgate on the same seeds. Clean false-alarm behaviour is taken from each arm's leave-one-seed-out transfer check.
reported: final ASR and max ASR over rounds 2-15
leave-one-seed-out clean FPR and retention of each arm's calibration
status: Development evidence on two seeds; describes what each component contributes, not a confirmatory claim.
